szoveg_eredeti:
🆕 Mistral Studio is our enterprise AI platform for putting frontier models like Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4) to work across your enterprise.

Today, we're expanding what you can build in Studio with new capabilities for agents and apps, alongside improvements to workflows, enterprise connections, observability and evaluations.

⚡ Build quickly. Create agents, workflows and apps for your business. Reuse shared infrastructure to get each new use case running faster.

🌍 Deploy where you choose. Run both the models and the platform in the cloud, your own VPC, on-premises or across a combination of environments.

🔒 Own and understand your AI. Decide what your systems can access and do, understand how they operate, and retain the expertise you develop through use.

Customers and partners including ABANCA , Accenture , ALTEN , BNP Paribas , Capgemini , CMA CGM and Tata Consultancy Services are already building with Studio.
